DigitCounter.addDigit: Add a digit to the counter
DigitCounter.setDigitColor: Set the counter display digit color
SevenSegDigit.setDigitAlpha: Set the display value to a digit character: '0'- '9'
SevenSegDigit.setRadix: Set the display radix of the digit
SevenSegDigit.setRadix|param|radix: of the digit display, eg: DigitRadix.Decimal
SevenSegDigit.setScale|param|scale: of the digit display, eg: SegmentScale.Full
sevenseg: Seven segment display digits and gizmos
sevenseg.createCounter: Create a seven segment counter display
sevenseg.createCounter|param|numDigits: the number of digits displayed, eg: 1
sevenseg.createCounter|param|scale: the size of the segments, eg: SegmentScale.Full
sevenseg.createCounter|param|thickness: the width of the segments, eg: SegmentStyle.Thick
sevenseg.createDigit: Create a seven segment display digit
sevenseg.createDigit|param|thickness: the width of the segments, eg: SegmentStyle.Thick
